title: A flat monomorphism of algebraic spaces is representable by schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma, attributed by the author to David Rydh, asserts that a flat monomorphism of algebraic spaces is representable by schemes. The proof reduces the statement to the situation of a flat monomorphism with affine target, where the monomorphism condition together with flatness forces the structure sheaf to be generated by a single idempotent-like element, so the space is a scheme; the general case then follows by covering. Forcing representability from flatness plus monomorphy is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 291-313.
